thievesguild_troublemaker_1.m: Hello. Don't I recognize you from somewhere?
r: No, I'm sure we have never met.
What do you do around here?
Can I take a look at what supplies you have available?
Umar sent me to talk about my first job here.

thievesguild_troublemaker_2.m: I keep an eye on our supplies for the guild.
r: Can I take a look at what you have available?
You must have me confused with someone else.
Maybe you have me confused with my brother Andor.
Have you seen my brother around here? He looks somewhat like me.

thievesguild_troublemaker_5.m: Oh yes, now that you mention it. There was that kid running around here, asking a lot of questions.
r: Do you know what he was looking for, or what he was doing?

thievesguild_troublemaker_6.m: No. I don't know. I just manage the supplies.

troublemaker_guild02_1.m: So do you want to kill her quietly?
r: No, just I want a suitable place to leave her until ...
What? No, I am just asking you for a place for this type of job. Umar told me you knew of somewhere.

troublemaker_guild02_10.m: Hey, what are you waiting for? Leave me and go talk with Umar or something!
r: You don't need to be rude! I will leave.

troublemaker_guild02_2a.m: Yeah, the ransom. I'm a veteran kid, don't forget that.

troublemaker_guild02_2b.m: Hmpf, be more specific next time. I'm not a mind-reader!

troublemaker_guild02_3.m: Well, I understand. Yes I have a place, but there's a problem. That place is at the other end of the town, next to the graveyard.
r: I don't think that will present a major problem for me.
I got here without any problem. Why I would have problems crossing through town?

troublemaker_guild02_4.m: Well, anyway, I'm building a way underground to reach it without being seen. It will be ready next time, I promise.
r: Thank you. I will go there.

troublemaker_guild02_5b.m: OK. Make sure you're not seen doing suspicious things!

troublemaker_guild02_6.m: I almost forgot. Take this key. Make sure you put it in correctly to open the hatchway.
r: Hmm, OK. I will keep that in mind.

troublemaker_guild02_7.m: I have better things to do than help an apprentice. Leave me. Hmpf.

troublemaker_guild02_8.m:
Ah, yes ... that captive. Take this food and make sure she is comfortable enough. We don't want her starving right?
(Troublemaker gives you some bread)
r: Argh. OK. What a tedious job!

troublemaker_guild02_9.m: Excellent. From now on me and my fellows will take care of her.
r: Very well. I will go and talk to Umar again. Bye.

troublemaker_guild_1.m: Argh, another annoying apprentice ... I mean, sorry. I know you were the one who brought us the key.

r: I have the journals, but one of your spies, Fanamor, was killed by a Feygard scout.
I gave you the journals, so where's my reward?
Well, but can I take a look at your supplies again?

troublemaker_guild_11a.m: Well done kid! You can now consider yourself skilled enough to be a part of this guild.
r: Yes .... So where is my reward?

troublemaker_guild_11b.m: Well, that is the price of being one of us. There's always risk.

troublemaker_guild_11c.m: Return to me when you are done.
r: Can you tell me again what I'm supposed to do?

troublemaker_guild_12a.m: You should talk with Umar. Maybe he has another task ... one that's more in your line of work, you know.
r: Sure, I will talk to him.
At least I got some gold. Bye!

troublemaker_guild_12b.m:
You have to retrieve information from our spies.
The first one is a spy in Crossglen, Leta. I believe you know her.
One of our veteran spies, Dunla, is disguised as a vendor in Vilegard Tavern.
And finally we have Fanamor, watching what is happening around Crossroads Guardhouse. Search for them in this order.

troublemaker_guild_13a.m: Hi again, kid. What do you want?
r: OK ... It's done. She's alright, and probably eating some bread now.
I still have to take our guest to her quarters.
I have to ...(you look at Ambelie) find a better place for her.
[Lie] I just recovered {10000} gold from my latest mission and was told to give it to The Guild.
I have found Defy and his men.
I'm confused. I gave Defy the fake key that you gave me, but what am I supposed to do now?
I have found Defy and his men.
[Lie] I have deposited the {10000} gold. Here is your key back, as promised.
I encountered Defy and his men and was forced to kill them!
[Lie] I have deposited the {10000} gold. Here is your key back, as promised.
Can I take a look at the Guild's current supplies?
[Lie] I have deposited the {10000} gold. Here is your key back, as promised.

troublemaker_guild_13b.m: And don't forget the password: You are no one. No one knows you. No one has seen you.

troublemaker_guild_3.m: As I expect you are aware, we're not welcome in many places. In fact, we're being pursued by Fallhaven patrols. That's why we are here. This place is safe.

troublemaker_guild_4.m: But we need supplies to survive, and also to maintain the Guild's influence. We are not just common robbers.

troublemaker_guild_5.m:
We don't just steal gold or goods. We steal information. Secrets, shipment reports, strategic locations.
Do you know what I mean?

troublemaker_guild_6.m: We have spies and scouts in certain key locations, gathering information. These locations are places frequented by people from Feygard and also from Nor City.

troublemaker_guild_7.m: So you will be the intermediary this time, collecting our spies' journals and bringing them to me.
r: That's not my favorite kind of job, but I will bring them.
No, I'm too strong to be just a mere broker.

troublemaker_guild_8a.m:
Good. We have three people on the job.
The first one is a spy in Crossglen, Leta. I believe you know her.
One of our veteran spies, Dunla, is disguised as a vendor in Vilegard Tavern.
And finally we have Fanamor, watching what is happening around Crossroads Guardhouse. Search for them in this order.

troublemaker_guild_8b.m: Hmpf. Go kill some beetles with your strength!

troublemaker_guild_9.m:
Ah! I almost forgot. You have to say the password if you want them to give you the journal.
The password is "You are no one. No one knows you. No one has seen you." Good luck.
r: I will keep that in mind. Bye.

troublemaker_wm_10.m: Great! Give it to me and when I have time, whenever that may be, I will add it to our bank.
r: Well, if you are so busy, I don't mind making the deposit for the greater good.

troublemaker_wm_15.m: Hmm... well I guess you could do that for me considering Umar trusts you a lot.
r: Great! Just tell me where to go and you can consider it done.

troublemaker_wm_20.m: Well, it's not that easy. You need more than the location. You need this key.
r: Thanks, but where is the vault located?

troublemaker_wm_25.m: You can find the empty house just south of here. Enter it and you will find your way.
r: Thank you so much! I will bring the key back as quick as possible.

troublemaker_wm_deffy_killed_10.m: You what? How? Where? Tell me all you know.
r: You're never going to believe this, but they were inside that vacant house when I walked in.
They looked up to no good, so I questioned them. Then the next thing I know, I'm caught up in the heat of battle and they are dead.

troublemaker_wm_deffy_killed_30.m: Can you prove this? Can you show me something that proves that all four are dead?
r: Yes. I looted their rings. [Shows them to Troublemaker]
Yes. I looted their rings, but I forgot to bring them with me. I'll come back.

troublemaker_wm_deffy_killed_40.m: Well, this is great news indeed. However, we would like to have them alive.

r: Southeast of Deebo's orchard. They were simply sitting in the woods around a campfire enjoying some of Sullengard's "Bandit Brews".

troublemaker_wm_report_15.m: What else can you tell me?
r: They wanted to hire me to rob you guys. Defy wants your stash of gold and treasures.
Well, I agreed to, but only because I want to help you guys catch him.

troublemaker_wm_report_25.m: You know, $playername, for just being a young adventurer, you are learning a lot.
r: Thanks a lot. I do feel a lot smarter now than I did before joining your guild.

troublemaker_wm_report_30.m: Listen, kid. Let's use this to our advantage. Take this fake key, bring it to Defy and we will be waiting for them at the vault.
r: Sir, that sounds like a great plan. What do you want me to do after handing him the fake key?

troublemaker_wm_report_35.m: You should go with them to the vault as we may need your help there.
r: Great! Just tell me where to go and you can consider it done.

troublemaker_wm_report_40.m: You can find the empty house just southwest of here. Enter it and you will find your way.

troublemaker_wm_report_45.m: Seriously? Man, it is so hard to get good help nowadays! I instructed you to go with them to the vault as we may need your help there.

troublemaker_wm_report_5.m: You what? How? Where? Tell me all you know.
r: I found them by pure luck, really.

troublemaker_wm_report_5_alt.m: Oh, yes. I was asking you what you said to Defy after learning that they wanted to hire you to rob us. Then you so rudely left the conversation. So I will ask you again. What did you say?
r: Well, I agreed to, but only because I want to help you guys catch him.
I encountered Defy and his men and was forced to kill them!

Thieves01.5:
After giving him the key of Luthor and talking with Umar about Andor, I needed to ask him about Thieves' Guild itself.
I want to join them to see what kind of jobs they do.
Thieves01.10: Umar told me to talk with Troublemaker regarding my first task for the Guild.
Thieves01.15: Troublemaker told me to bring him three journals from spies of the guild. First I have to talk with Leta in my village, then with Dunla in Vilegard's tavern, and finally with Fanamor somewhere around Crossroads guardhouse.
Thieves01.20: I have to remember to tell them the password "You are no one. No one knows you. No one has seen you."
Thieves01.25: Leta gave me her journal and advised me to not raise suspicion.
Thieves01.30: I got Dunla's journal without any problem. I have set out to get the last journal.
Thieves01.40: Fanamor has been gravely wounded, and the Feygard Scout grabbed the journal.
Thieves01.45: After I had killed the Feygard scout I talked again with Fanamor. She's losing blood quickly, so I have to bring her a bandage. I need to find a trustworthy priest.
Thieves01.50: Thoronir gave me a bandage. I have to return to Fanamor as soon as possible.
Thieves01.51: Unfortunately, I was not able to save Fanamor's life. However, I did get her journal.
Thieves01.55: Fanamor is alive and will find her own way to return.
Thieves01.60: I returned to Troublemaker and gave him the journals. He told me to talk with Umar, maybe he has another task for me.

wanted_men.10: Off the main road, southeast of Deebo's Orchard, I've stumbled across a group of sketchy looking men with familiar voices.
wanted_men.15: The sketchy looking men with familiar voices turned out to be the Aidem thieves from Sullengard. They were hiding-out in the woods.
wanted_men.20: While speaking with Defy, I've learned the he and his men have a grudge against the Thieves' Guild and they want to "hit them where it really hurts". Whatever that means.
wanted_men.25: Defy has revealed the location of the Thieves' Guild's vault of treasure - an underground storage unit accessible from the vacant house south of Fallhaven.
wanted_men.30: Defy has asked me to convince Troublemaker to let me borrow the key long enough that I can bring it back to Defy.
wanted_men.35: Defy has agreed to pay me 20 percent of the looted Thieves' Guild treasure if I get the key from Troublemaker and hand it over to him.
wanted_men.40: Defy has instructed me to bring Troublemaker's key to him at their new hideout located west of the Sutdover River, where the rail tracks end.
wanted_men.45: I have talked my way into acquiring the Thieves' Guild's vault key from Troublemaker, but I must return it to him quickly after I am done with it.
wanted_men.50: I told Troublemaker all that I knew about Defy, his men, and the "Lost Traveler", Alaric and how they hired me to help rob the Thieves' Guild.
wanted_men.55: Troublemaker has asked me to help him trap Defy by providing Defy with a fake key. When Defy arrives at the secret vault, the Guild members will be waiting for him.
wanted_men.56:
I gave Defy the fake version of the vault key that Troublemaker gave me. In return, Defy has given me a fake version of Troublemaker's vault key and has instructed me to return it to Troublemaker.
Defy then told me to report back to the vault in order to collect my share of the gold. He has no idea that the key I gave him is a fake.
wanted_men.57: I have reported back to the vacant house and I met Rennik there. He informed me that the Thieves' Guild has apprehended all five men and that they are now in the Guild jail.
wanted_men.60: Defy has given me a fake version of Troublemaker's vault key and has instructed me to return it to Troublemaker. Then I should report back to the vault in order to collect my share of the gold.
wanted_men.65: I have given the fake Aidem key to Troublemaker as a replacement for the real vault key.
wanted_men.70: I reported back to Defy and he rewarded me with 25000 gold.
wanted_men.75: I told Defy that I was keeping the key for myself and plan to loot the Thieves' Guild's vault myself. A fight ensued.
wanted_men.76: I have killed Defy, his three henchmen and Alaric. I really should go back to Fallhaven and talk to Troublemaker again.
wanted_men.77: I've unlocked the hatch leading to the vault. It's time to head down.
wanted_men.80: I informed Troublemaker that Defy and his men are now dead.

Thieves02.2: After completing my first task I'm considered a member of Thieves' Guild. Now I have to perform a very risky task. Umar sent me to kidnap a noble woman from Feygard, without being discovered.
Thieves02.4: She was recently seen in the Foaming Flask tavern.
Thieves02.6: Umar gave me some advice. My strength is not always the solution. I must "use my tongue" to avoid raising suspicion in the tavern.
Thieves02.10: Ambelie Laumwill doesn't want to come with me peacefully. I cannot make a scene, or the guards will alert other patrols. Maybe talking with them would solve the situation.
Thieves02.15: I have "used my tongue" with the main Feygard soldier in the Foaming Flask tavern. He gave me permission to "escort back" Ambelie.
Thieves02.20: I knocked out Ambelie. I will take her back to the Guild.
Thieves02.21: I have decided not to kidnap Ambelie. I must think of another solution.
Thieves02.24: Ambelie gave me a very valuable necklace. I must talk with Umar and persuade him to no longer pursue her.
Thieves02.30: I safely brought Ambelie to the basement. However, keeping her here could be dangerous.
Thieves02.35: Umar believes there is a secure room for these types of "visitors". I should talk to Troublemaker.
Thieves02.40: I have talked to Troublemaker about the place Umar believes it's okay to safely keep the hostage.
Thieves02.45: Troublemaker has given me the key to the Guild brig. I should take Ambelie there and leave her to wake up.
Thieves02.50: I've inserted the key and moved the lever. A hatchway has opened in the room.
Thieves02.55: I left Ambelie in that ugly, dark, and cold place. I should go back.
Thieves02.60: Troublemaker gave me some bread for Ambelie. The guild doesn't want her to starve to death. Indeed, they want her to be as comfortable as possible. I must go to the brig again.
Thieves02.65: I gave the bread to Ambelie. I should report Troublemaker that I completed the job.
Thieves02.70: The job finally seems to be finished. I just have to talk with Umar again. However, I do not feel good about this. Kidnappings are definitely not my kind of job.
Thieves02.75: I completed this task successfully. Umar told me they have sent couriers to Feygard, and the ransom is almost guaranteed. He paid me for my work.
Thieves02.76: Umar took the necklace as compensation for my errors. Everything is fine again.
